article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language first-anniversary blog post by new Free Realms producer Nick Parkinson. It says the game officially launched one year earlier, claims over ten million players, mentions an anniversary update and all-day anniversary events, and previews unspecified summer content (new pets, items, mounts, housing decor and summer-camp-style events). The exact post date is not stated in the text.
